release.notes_on_special_items: Q3-2022 release. Adjusted EBITA 92.7; Russia adjusted EBITA 10.8; core adjusted EBITA 81.9. Adjusted tax rate 24.4%. Russia adjusted EPS 0.13. Q1-2022 release showed Q3-2021 segment OI Americas 31.5 / EMEA 47.1 / Total 78.6 and adj EBITDA 42.3 / 60.0 / 102.3 (rounding/allocation differences vs Q3-2022 release used here).

notes: Form 10 Information Statement (Ex.99.1, 10-12B/A filed 2022-03-17) now used: audited combined (carve-out) statements FY2019-FY2021 of the 'Fabrication Technology Business of Colfax Corporation', summary historical data (covers 2019-2021 only), MD&A and notes. The Form 10 has no EPS for historical periods (pro forma 2021 only) and no interim (2021 quarterly / Sep-2021) statements.

Pre-spin carve-out (combined) presentation: ESAB was the Fabrication Technology business of Colfax/Enovis until the April 4, 2022 Separation. Asbestos-holding entities, certain pension plans and debt were contributed at Separation and are NOT in 2019-2021 statements (10-K Note 1).
EPS for pre-spin periods computed by the company on 60,034,311 shares (shares distributed at Separation); basic = diluted. No dividends declared pre-spin (dps_declared=0).
CF 'Proceeds from borrowings on revolving credit facility and other 244' mapped to revolver_net (proceeds only; no repayments).

10-Q segment net sales: Americas 260,005, EMEA & APAC 345,963 thousand; Adjusted EBITA 38,627 / 54,093 / 92,720 thousand; EBITA recon: Separation 713, Amortization of acquired intangibles 8,934, Other 182 thousand.
Adj EBITDA recon residual -0.1 and segment build-up residuals (Americas 31.6+1.8+0.2+4.6+0.3+3.9=42.4 vs 42.6; EMEA 59.9 ok; Total 102.4 vs 102.5) are rounding of printed millions.
Russia net sales Q3-2021 44.2 (Q3-2022 release footnote); 9M-2021 'Russia' figures in Q3 release cover Q2+Q3 only (88.2 sales, 23.1 adj EBITDA).
Interest add-back printed '—' in Q3-2021 adj EBITDA recon (IS interest & other was (209) thousand; ~0.2 retained as 'Other').

BS: no interim balance sheet exists in the Form 10 (it contains only FY2019-FY2021 annual combined statements) or elsewhere; only equity components (2022 10-Q statement of equity) and cash (CF) populated.
